change: Decode PostgreSQL BIT and VARBIT array elements with the existing scalar decoder and allow their static built-in casts for typed updates/imports.
baseline: Failed first because BIT[] returned Undecodable instead of a lossless array value.

run.command: rtk cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration value_contract_bit_arrays_roundtrip_wire_and_csv -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

additional_checks: rtk cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-core postgres_array_update_casts_allowlist_type_metadata: passed
rtk cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings: passed
proves: bit[] and varbit[] decode as text array values
fixed-width values, 1/8/9-bit varying values, empty bit strings, SQL NULL, and a zero-based lower bound retain native array semantics
native type and array_to_json values match after text-parameter rebinding
typed CSV import restores all values, NULL states, native types, and array_send bytes
scope_limit: This closes the BIT/VARBIT array result, rebind, and CSV path only; other PostgreSQL array families, consumers, session configurations, and B3 acceptance remain open.
